summary: Maintain A Bill Of Material (Bom) For A Pharmaceutical Finished Produc
description: As a Master Data Specialist, I want to maintain a Bill of Material (BOM) for a pharmaceutical finished product that includes active ingredient percentages and approved excipient substitutes, so that production always uses a validated and regulatory-compliant formula.
acceptanceCriteria: 1. The user can access the "Manage Bills of Material" Fiori app.2. The system requires each BOM component to reference an approved, active material master record.3. The system supports alternative/substitute components, each individually flagged with regulatory approval status.4. Any change to a released BOM triggers a new version and requires re-approval before use in a process order.5. The system prevents process order creation against a BOM version not in "Released" status.6. The system maintains a full change history of BOM revisions for regulatory audit purposes.
